component.name: ChannelItem
component.script:
sub init() m.bg = m.top.findNode("bg") m.logo = m.top.findNode("logo") m.name = m.top.findNode("name") end sub
sub onContent() c = m.top.itemContent if c = invalid then return m.name.text = c.title m.logo.uri = c.hdposterurl end sub
sub onFocus() if m.top.itemHasFocus m.bg.color = "0xE5231FFF" else m.bg.color = "0x00000066" end if end sub
